notes.title: Better blocking update.
notes.content:
This update changes blocking to be more fluid and adds in ways to adjust the zoom of the camera.
[list]
[*] The E key now zooms the camera in and the Q key zooms it out.
[*] Blocking can now interrupt attacks.
[*] Changing blocking direction is now much more fluid.
[/list]

tags.feature: The E key now zooms the camera in and the Q key zooms it out.

tags.balance_change: Changing blocking direction is now much more fluid.

notes.title: Balance changes and photo mode
notes.content:
- You can now hide the in game text by hitting the minus button. This allows for better screenshots

- The first enemy in the tutorial now deals less damage.
